title: OpenVA Agent Enrichment Result
description: Host-neutral per-row enrichment result emitted by the MCP enrich_inventory tool and the match-service /v1/enrich endpoint. The preferred agent contract is identity + source_references: a stable match/no_match identity projection and destination-neutral indexed public source references. Compatibility fields remain for older adapters. Optional entity_resolution is a compact status block only; detailed evidence stays in source/legal-entity records or diagnostic profiles. The result records public-source references and machine-state notes only; it never carries a compliance, suitability, approval, or risk conclusion.

row_id.description: The caller correlation id, echoed verbatim.

input.description: The bounded identity that was matched, echoed back.

identity.description: Preferred first-class agent identity projection. New consumers should depend on this block instead of interpreting the compatibility match object directly.

entity_resolution.description: Optional compact legal-entity resolution summary. Omit unless legal-entity data is available or useful for the caller. This block exposes status, stable ids, and a reason code only; evidence details are dereferenced through source/legal-entity records or a diagnostic profile.

source_references.description: Preferred first-class agent source-reference projection keyed by requested source type. Each value is an indexed public source reference, or a neutral not_indexed/gated/unavailable/not_applicable state. New consumers should map this object into their destination schema.

match.description: Compatibility identity object for existing consumers. New consumers should use identity.

sources.description: Compatibility source list for existing consumers. New consumers should use source_references.

primary_source_by_type.description: Compatibility projection: the primary source object per source_type, chosen deterministically by the shared ranking. New consumers should use source_references.

source_urls_by_type.description: Compatibility projection: original source URLs grouped by source_type. New consumers should use source_references.

notes.description: Machine-state notes only (e.g. ambiguous match, no indexed OpenVA match, missing indexed source type). Never a compliance conclusion.

not_advice.description: Always true. OpenVA returns public-source references, not advice.

match_status.description: Preferred normalized identity status. Ambiguity is represented as no_match with no_match_reason=multiple_plausible_entities.

status.description: Compact legal-entity resolution status. Brand matching remains in identity; this block is scoped to legal-entity ids only.

matched_entity_id.description: The resolved legal entity id when exactly one evidence-supported entity is selected; otherwise null.

candidate_entity_ids.description: Evidence-supported legal-entity candidates when the brand/entity relationship is ambiguous. Empty for resolved, unmatched, not_requested, or not_supported states.

review_required.description: True when the caller must supply more discriminating input or perform review before treating a legal entity as resolved.

reason_code.description: Compact machine reason code. Evidence-quorum details belong in diagnostics, not this default block.

status.description: Neutral indexed-source state. It is not a compliance, security, risk, or procurement conclusion.

Compatibility status. New consumers should map matched -> identity.match_status=match; ambiguous -> identity.match_status=no_match with no_match_reason=multiple_plausible_entities; no_match -> identity.match_status=no_match.
